scope: Every public work: effective built-page exposure, preview GLB material channels, conversion invariant. This is not a physical outdoor test on 1046 objects; native AR also adapts lighting to the camera surroundings.
webXR: Uses the page renderer, material objects, exposure, tone mapping and environment; no extra material compensation.
quickLook: Applies the current page exposure once to cloned linear material colour; retains texture references, normal maps and PBR parameters; bakes emissive intensity once.
